messages.subject: WITHOUT PREJUDICE & SUBJECT TO CONTRACT - Garrety
messages.plaintextBody:
Oliver,

We act for Pennington Industries Limited. Please find attached a without-prejudice letter, also sent as a protected conversation under s.111A ERA 1996, setting out proposed settlement terms for your client. The headline is a package of around £233k gross (PILON, statutory redundancy and an £85k ex-gratia), plus a legal-fees contribution and an agreed reference. The offer is open for 14 days.

We'd welcome a constructive discussion.

Kind regards,
Tom Gallagher
Associate | Employment & Disputes
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0834
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.plaintextBody:
Tom,

Thank you. My client is willing to engage but the ex-gratia is light given the strength of the whistleblowing and age points - we've prepared a schedule of loss running well north of £300k. We're looking for £95k on the ex-gratia, a £2,500 fees contribution, outplacement, and the restrictive covenants reduced to 9 months. Draft agreement welcome.

Oliver Jennings
Partner, Birchall Stone LLP
